metadata.title: Cabling formula and colored knot Floer homology
metadata.abstract: We study colored knot Floer homology via a bordered cabling construction. We construct a cabling module and identify the connecting maps in the defining direct system at the level of this module. By taking the colimit at the chain level, we obtain a general formula for colored knot Floer homology of an arbitrary knot in terms of its ordinary knot Floer homology and the colored unknot algebra. This extends the computation of Alishahi-Gorsky-Liu from L-space knots to all knots.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: colored knot Floer 的一般 cabling 公式
analysis.workSummary: 通过 bordered cabling module 和连接映射直接系统的 chain colimit，将任意 knot 的 colored knot Floer 写为普通 knot Floer 与 colored unknot 代数的组合。
analysis.breakthrough: 把此前 L-space 情形的 cabling 理论推广到任意 knot。
analysis.limitations: 需使用文中指定的连接映射与 colimit，不能只把同调群作形式张量积。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 6 建议先在 chain level 取 colimit 再计算 homology 的关键观察，推动第 9 节一般证明；全部论证随后由作者核验。
